comment_regular: Verified (Oblivion): returns 1 when the amplitude field at TESEffectShader+0x64 is nonpositive; otherwise returns sin(2π * activeElapsedSeconds * frequency at +0x68) * amplitude. TESEffectShader_AnimateTextureEffect multiplies edge alpha by (1 + this pulse) and clamps the result. Edge-alpha pulse role is direct; field names are Probable from Fallout's corresponding EffectShaderData layout.
